title: Tight Shoes Hour by Hour
hook: Your feet start screaming after just one hour.

beats.label: 1 HR
beats.line: After about an hour, your toes may tingle as circulation slows.
beats.idea: Close-up of foot, toes glowing faintly blue.

beats.label: 2 HRS
beats.line: After a couple of hours, the foot can swell and the shoe may dig in tighter.
beats.idea: Foot expands, shoe edge pressing into skin.

beats.label: 4 HRS
beats.line: After several hours, blisters can develop on the ball of the foot and the skin may redden.
beats.idea: Cartoon foot shows raised blister and red patches.

beats.label: 8 HRS
beats.line: After many hours, nerves may fire sharp pain and you might limp.
beats.idea: Foot highlighted with electric sparks, character limps.

beats.label: 12 HRS
beats.line: After a long period, foot muscles can fatigue and you may shift weight forward.
beats.idea: Foot arch flattens, character hunches forward.

description: A quick look at how tight shoes squeeze the foot and strain the body over hours.
topic: What happens if you wear tight shoes for hours?
